modelingNotes: Camp North End: 1720 Statesville Avenue — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-1720-statesville.ts

The south-west end of the Army Quartermaster Corps' Building No. 4 (1941–43); the building's middle was taken down for Kinship West and its north-east end is `clt-cne-301-camp-road`. A one-storey red-brick box 56 × 74 m, two corrugated-metal clerestory monitors across its width, a lower wing on its north-west side, and on the south-east side a loading dock under a deep flat steel canopy.
Identity: the red brick box with its two silver-and-glass monitors, and the dock canopy on the south-east side.

Evidence: - OSM: the outline way/1017983351 (no height) and its 6 parts: the monitors way/1017983346, 1017983348 (height 9), the main roof 1017983345, 1017983347, 1017983349 (6.9) and the low north-west wing 1017983350 (5.8). - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 1 m (measured, NAVD88): ground 228.1–228.3 (y = 0 is 228.1); deck 235.4 (7.3 m); monitors 238.2 (10.1 m); wing 234.0 (5.9 m). - C-M Historic Landmarks Commission survey report (2017, landmarkscommission.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ford-Motor-Co-Plant-SR.pdf), Buildings Nos. 4–6 (published): brick in common bond, corrugated-metal clerestory monitors crossing the width, 180 ft wide. - Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903102 (CAMP LANDOWNER LP): 1943 face brick among the parcel's buildings. - Mapillary 360° photo 585774473263517 (cbreedlove, 2022-06-10, CC BY-SA 4.0), taken 24 m south-east of the south-east face: red brick, the dock under a flat steel canopy with loading doors, the south monitor clad in silver corrugated metal over a tall glazed band. - USGS NAIP orthophoto (public domain): white roofs.

Estimated: the canopy's extent (y −31..9, 5.5 m deep, 5.6 m high) and the door spacing, from the one photo; window sizes. The north-west face (on Statesville Avenue) and both ends are unphotographed and kept plain: a few windows, guessed. The photo predates the 2022–24 renovation's finish; no name is published for the building, so it takes its address.
Frame and kit: `clt-cne-301-camp-road.ts`. y along the long axis (bearing 39.47°), placement bearing 39.47; origin at the outline's centroid, lng −80.8351307, lat 35.2447837.
